title: PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, Amnesia: The Bunker
summary: Shred rails, fight icons and flee horrors beyond your understanding with the PlayStation Plus Monthly Games for December. Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4, Dragon Ball Xenoverse 2, and Amnesia: The Bunker will be available to all PlayStation Plus members* from Tuesday, December 1 to Monday January 4.  Let’s take a closer look at each of […]
